Contributing to nprcgenekeepr

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest. You do not need to write code to help: a clear problem report from someone who manages a colony is one of the most useful contributions this package can receive.

  • Report a problem or ask for a feature. Open an Issue. No setup is needed. Please show the problem with the package’s example data, and do not post real colony records, because Issues are public.
  • Change the code or the documentation. Fork the repository, make your change on a branch, and open a pull request against master. A pull request includes tests for what it changes and passes the package check and lint.

The contributor guide says what to put in an Issue and walks through setting up a copy of the package, where things live, running the tests, updating the documentation and proposing a change. Its source is vignettes/articles/contributing.qmd.

Everyone taking part is asked to follow the code of conduct.

Developed by Michael Raboin, Terry Therneau, Amanda Vinson, R. Mark Sharp, Matthew Schultz, Southwest National Primate Research Center, Oregon National Primate Research Center.
